  "street": "string",  //Optional
  "houseNumber": "string",  //Optional
  "additionalAddressInfo": "string",  //Optional
  "city": "string",  //Optional
  "zipcode": "string",  //Optional
  "province": "string",  //Optional
  "countryISO": "string",  //Optional
  "phoneContactInformationEntries": [
    {
      "phonecode": "string",  //  Please give the Country ISO-Code. For example enter "AT" for phonecode "+43"
      "phonePrefix": 0,  // Prefix of the phone number. Must be a number value. 
      "value": "string", // This is the main part of the phone number. Everything after phone-code and phone-prefix
      "categoryID": 0,  // Describes which Category the Entry is in. See in section Miscellaneous for detailed information on valid values. E.g. 1 - 'Business', 2 - 'Company' etc. 
      "isMainContact": 0 //  At least one entry of phoneContactInformationEntries array needs to be marked as main contact
    }
  ],
  "emailContactInformationEntries": [
    {
      "value": "string",  // This is the actual e-mail address
      "categoryID": 0,  // Describes which Category the Entry is in. See in section Miscellaneous for detailed information on valid values. E.g. 1 - 'Business', 2 - 'Company' etc. 
      "isMainContact": 0  // At least one entry of emailContactInformationEntries array needs to be marked as main contact
    }
  ],
  "otherContactInformationEntries": [
    {
      "typeID": 0,  // See in section Miscellaneous for detailed information on valid values
      "typeDescription": "string",  // Describes Other Information (for Social Media). 
      "value": "string". // This is the actual link to the website or social media platform
    }
  ]
}
